title: Planned maintenance: nbn services connected via Petrie, Caboolture and Aspley (QLD)
current_summary: The planned maintenance on nbn services connected through the Petrie, Caboolture and Aspley areas in Queensland is complete. The work finished at 7:00am on Tuesday 3 November 2026 (Queensland time).

cause.reason: Planned splice infrastructure replacement by a network provider.

updates.content: A network provider will be replacing splice infrastructure that supports nbn services connected through the Petrie, Caboolture and Aspley areas in Queensland. The work is scheduled between 11:00pm on Monday 2 November and 7:00am on Tuesday 3 November 2026 (Queensland time). Some nbn services in these areas may be interrupted for up to 8 hours during this window. We will share more information if anything changes.

The planned splice infrastructure replacement affecting nbn services connected through the Petrie, Caboolture and Aspley areas began at 11:00pm on Monday 2 November (Queensland time). Some services may be interrupted for up to 8 hours, and the work is scheduled to finish by 7:00am on Tuesday 3 November. We will update you if the schedule changes.

The planned splice infrastructure replacement affecting nbn services connected through the Petrie, Caboolture and Aspley areas is complete as of 7:00am on Tuesday 3 November 2026 (Queensland time). Services that were interrupted during the maintenance window should no longer be affected.
